classification.reason: Request is a scientific goal or asks for planning without a concrete workflow.

plan.goal: Generate 1–2 binder candidates against a user-supplied target structure via RFdiffusion backbone generation → ProteinMPNN sequence design → Protenix v2 complex refolding → ipSAE interface confidence scoring → protein QC → deterministic rank-ordered candidate list.
assumptions: No hotspot residues were supplied; RFdiffusion binder_design runs without hotspot guidance and will sample the full accessible target surface — binding site specificity may be lower than a hotspot-guided run.
Binder length defaults to 70–100 aa; override with params.binder_length_min and params.binder_length_max.
Two RFdiffusion shards (seeds 1 and 2) run in parallel to provide backbone diversity while keeping GPU cost at two single-design jobs.
ProteinMPNN temperature 0.1 strongly favours sequences that recover the diffused backbone geometry; one sequence per backbone is designed to match the requested 1–2 candidate budget.

The workflow execution engine constructs the Protenix-format input JSON for each complex from the ProteinMPNN best-sequence output and the target chain in the original PDB; ${outputs.mpnn_N.protenix_input_json} is expected to be populated by the engine adapter before fold_N executes.
Protenix v2 runs without MSA and without templates for speed; n_sample 3 gives a small ensemble from which the best-confidence model is forwarded to ipSAE.
ipSAE chain A is the target chain, chain B is the designed binder, matching standard VPA complex chain ordering produced by the engine.
No ligand, cofactor, or nucleic-acid context is assumed; proteinmpnn is used instead of ligandmpnn.
submit_candidate is excluded from this plan; a post-round agent step will decide whether to submit after inspecting rank_designs output.
missing_inputs: target_pdb: absolute path to the target protein PDB file — required by rfdiffusion binder_design and must be provided at runtime before the workflow can execute.

success_criteria.terminal_output: rank_designs top-2 list with all five QC scalars and the ipSAE interface confidence score for each candidate
